source: Ministère de l'Intérieur, Liste des radars fixes en France, data.gouv.fr ; direction des routes et radars en plus : contributeurs d'OpenStreetMap (ODbL)
about: Danger zones, not cameras: centres rounded to 0.002 degree, several cameras in one cell are one zone, no type. zones: [lat / cell, lon / cell, speed limit km/h (0: unknown), 1 for a wide zone, the road's direction in degrees from north (-1: unknown), flags (1: one-way road, 2: in town)].
